rules.title: Watch precisely, derive with computed
rules.what: Watch the specific property that matters or derive it with computed; avoid deep watchers and deep reactivity on large payloads.
rules.why: deep: true walks the whole object graph at every change; deep reactive proxies on large immutable data add overhead for updates that never happen.
rules.how: watch(() => state.filter, ...); computed for derivations; shallowRef/markRaw for large immutable data; v-once for static blocks.

patterns.note: Deep watcher; check the size of the watched object.

verify.how: Vue devtools performance timeline shows the update scope limited to what changed.

rules.title: Lazy-load routes and optional components
rules.what: Load routes and optional components with dynamic imports; keep hydration to the interactive parts.
rules.why: Importing every view at the top of the router ships the whole application to a visitor who opens one page.
rules.how: component: () => import('../views/Page.vue'); defineAsyncComponent for heavy optional widgets.

patterns.note: Eager view import; a component used on every route may legitimately stay eager.

verify.how: Bundle report shows one chunk per route; initial JS within budget.

rules.title: Stable keys and cleaned watchers
rules.what: Give v-for items stable keys from their data, and stop manual watchers, listeners and timers on unmount.
rules.why: Index keys rebuild nodes on every reorder; a watcher or listener left behind keeps the component and its data alive.
rules.how: :key="item.id"; const stop = watch(...); onUnmounted(stop); clear timers in onUnmounted.

verify.how: Mount/unmount cycles leave no listener or timer active.
